snippet.title: Sideswipe: Project 053 II - Natomic Studios (2003)
snippet.description:
Sideswipe is a fast-paced side scrolling arcade game. It's a sequel to Natomic Studios' 2001 release, Project 053.

Game By: Brad Estey
Music By: Aurelien Boudet & Johan Ejnasson

Download - https://natomic.com
